Test Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Broadcast (ADS-B) technology,
Description

Designed to test Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Broadcast (ADS-B) technology, which enables space-based monitoring of aircraft position, velocity, and trajectory. The satellite will validate ADS-B signal reception from orbit, assessing its effectiveness for space-based surveillance of unmanned aerial vehicles operating in atmospheric flight.
